column2: Band 1 takes 100 percent of income; R400 earner has a R400 floor and necessarily no discretionary income. Correct and not to be special-cased into a pass.
Band 1 upper bound. Bands include their upper bound.
One cent into band 2. Continuous at the edge by construction; the band IDENTITY changes and that is what the adjudicator reads.
Band 6 upper edge. Income of exactly R25 000.00 is band 6 and not band 7.
One cent into band 7. The floor does not jump; the identity does.
Band 6 with two dependants. Fixed component 260066 cents from the expanded table; not a multiplier applied at read time.
Band 6 with five-or-more dependants. Bucket 5 covers 5 and above.
Band 12 is unbounded and its marginal rate continues indefinitely.
The absolute ceiling binds. R3m a month gives a table norm above R203 000; the Bank stops it at R20 000. Recorded because it is a departure upward from the table in the applicant's favour.
